question: What expiation applies likewise in the case of the pavilion and similar structures?
premises: The same rule applies in this case.
The case includes the pavilion and similar structures.
inference: The same expiation applies for the pavilion and similar structures, O elders born of Śiva.
uncertainties: The exact sense of śivāgrajāḥ as an address is somewhat uncertain.
plain_english: O elders born of Śiva, the same expiation applies likewise in the case of the pavilion and the like.
